product.asphalt.name: Asphalt
category.highways.name: Highways
category.highways.description: Rail-planned highways sized for T1/T2, T3, and massive T4 vehicles, with terrain ramps and automatic traffic-director access.
prototype.highway-segment.name: Highway segment
prototype.highway-segment.description: Asphalt segment with a gravel foundation, generated by the rail planner.
prototype.highway-segment-t3.name: T3 heavy highway segment
prototype.highway-segment-t3.description: Eight-tile asphalt segment with one four-tile heavy lane in each direction.
prototype.highway-segment-t4.name: T4 massive highway segment
prototype.highway-segment-t4.description: Sixteen-tile asphalt segment with two four-tile lanes in each direction.
prototype.on-ramp.name: Highway on-ramp
prototype.on-ramp.description: One-way access from terrain onto the highway. The arrow points in the driving direction; the road side must snap to the end of a highway segment.
prototype.on-ramp-v3.description: Directed access from terrain onto the highway. The selected lane node determines the direction.
prototype.off-ramp.name: Highway off-ramp
prototype.off-ramp.description: One-way exit from the highway to terrain. The arrow points in the driving direction; on-ramps and off-ramps are independent.
prototype.off-ramp-v3.description: Directed exit from the highway to terrain. The selected lane node determines the direction.
prototype.t-intersection.name: Highway T-intersection
prototype.t-intersection.description: Uncontrolled three-way highway intersection with all six directed turning movements.
prototype.cross-intersection.name: Highway intersection
prototype.cross-intersection.description: Uncontrolled four-way highway intersection with straight, left-turn, and right-turn movements.
prototype.roundabout.name: Highway roundabout
prototype.roundabout.description: Four-arm roundabout for right-hand traffic. Each entrance can reach any of the other three exits.
tool.highway.name: Build T1/T2 highway
tool.highway.description: Builds highways with the rail DLC curve and pivot planner. Different point heights create smooth terrain ramps. E raises and Q lowers the roadway; supported sections receive concrete pillars. Left-click places points, double-click builds, and right-click cancels. Hold Shift while double-clicking to continue seamlessly from the endpoint. The traffic director automatically connects vehicles to the nearest useful highway.
tool.highway-t3.name: Build T3 heavy highway
tool.highway-t3.description: Builds an eight-tile road with one four-tile lane in each direction. It gives T3 and modded massive vehicles safe opposing clearance and uses the same curve, ramp, and elevation planner.
tool.highway-t4.name: Build T4 multilane highway
tool.highway-t4.description: Builds a sixteen-tile road with two heavy lanes in each direction. Fast vehicles statically prefer the inner passing lane while slower vehicles prefer the outer driving lane. E/Q, pivots, ramps, and seamless continuation work like the standard highway.
tool.t-intersection.name: Build T-intersection
tool.t-intersection.description: Places a three-way intersection. It snaps only to free ends of normal highway segments; a short highway segment is required between two nodes. Rotate to change its orientation.
tool.cross-intersection.name: Build four-way intersection
tool.cross-intersection.description: Places an uncontrolled four-way intersection with straight, left-turn, and right-turn movements. A short highway segment is required between two nodes.
tool.roundabout.name: Build roundabout
tool.roundabout.description: Places a four-arm roundabout for right-hand traffic. All movements follow the same circular direction. A short highway segment is required between two nodes.
error.junction-spacing: Intersections and roundabouts cannot overlap or be placed directly next to each other. Build a short highway segment between them.
legacy.one-way-entrance.name: Ground road: one-way entrance
legacy.one-way-entrance.description: Terrain-to-road connector for a directed ground road. The build arrow shows the driving direction.
legacy.one-way-exit.name: Ground road: one-way exit
legacy.one-way-exit.description: Road-to-terrain connector for a directed ground road. The build arrow shows the driving direction.
legacy.one-way-straight.name: Ground road: one-way straight
legacy.one-way-straight.description: Directed twelve-tile road segment. Connect an entrance at the start and an exit at the end.
legacy.one-way-curve.name: Ground road: one-way 90-degree curve
legacy.one-way-curve.description: Directed 90-degree road curve. Rotate or reflect it while placing to obtain the required turn.
legacy.two-way-entrance.name: Ground road: two-way entrance
legacy.two-way-entrance.description: Combined terrain entrance and exit for a two-way ground road. Both lanes support every truck size.
legacy.two-way-straight.name: Ground road: two-way straight
legacy.two-way-straight.description: Twelve-tile two-way road segment with one lane in each direction. Hold the left mouse button and drag for repeated straight pieces, or use the two-way drag-line tool for automatic entrances.
legacy.two-way-curve.name: Ground road: two-way 90-degree curve
legacy.two-way-curve.description: Two-way 90-degree road curve. Rotate or reflect it while placing to obtain the required turn.
legacy.tile-straight.name: Ground road tiles: straight
legacy.tile-straight.description: Four-tile, non-blocking two-way road section. Use the straight-line tool; access nodes are inserted automatically.
legacy.tile-access.name: Ground road tiles: access node
legacy.tile-access.description: Automatic terrain access for straight ground road tiles.
legacy.native-straight.name: Ground road: native straight line
legacy.native-straight.description: Four-tile native two-way road section. Every section has terrain entrances and exits for both directions.
legacy.surface.name: Ground road surface (legacy)
legacy.surface.description: Compatibility prototype for saves made with Ground Roads 1.3.1.
